verdict.rationale: Statsig explicitly documents a Console API described as 'the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI,' directly matching the story, plus a CLI for managing gates/experiments and an HTTP API for evaluation/logging without an SDK. This is strong first-party evidence of API/UI parity across core workflows (gates, experiments, dynamic configs, access management via SSO/SCIM APIs implied). Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification that every single UI action (e.g., autotune, warehouse-native setup, layers) is exposed via API, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (probe returned 404s), leaving some completeness unconfirmed.
